Part of [`evoxc.ir`](/api/evoxc/ir/)

One declared attribute of an op.

## Attributes

- `name` · `str` — Attribute key.

- `type` · `str` — One of the `ATTR_*` tags.

- `default` · `Any` — Default value; if omitted the attribute is required.

- `description` · `str` — What the attribute controls.

## required

True if the attribute must be present on every op instance.
